# terrakube_registry_provider_implementation (Resource)

The download of a version of a provider you host in the private registry, for one operating system and architecture. Terraform and OpenTofu are pointed at `download_url` and check the file against `shasum`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_registry_provider" "internal" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name            = "internal"
}

resource "terrakube_registry_provider_version" "current" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  provider_id     = data.terrakube_registry_provider.internal.id
  version_number  = "1.2.3"
  protocols       = ["6.0"]
}

# The public GPG key that signed the SHA256SUMS file, ASCII armored.
variable "signing_key" {
  type = string
}

# One implementation for each operating system and architecture of the release.
resource "terrakube_registry_provider_implementation" "linux_amd64" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  provider_id     = data.terrakube_registry_provider.internal.id
  version_id      = terrakube_registry_provider_version.current.id

  os           = "linux"
  arch         = "amd64"
  filename     = "terraform-provider-internal_1.2.3_linux_amd64.zip"
  download_url = "https://releases.example.com/internal/1.2.3/terraform-provider-internal_1.2.3_linux_amd64.zip"
  shasum       = "5d9c0ab18b6e3b7a7c2f1f0d8a3f2c8f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d"

  shasums_url           = "https://releases.example.com/internal/1.2.3/terraform-provider-internal_1.2.3_SHA256SUMS"
  shasums_signature_url = "https://releases.example.com/internal/1.2.3/terraform-provider-internal_1.2.3_SHA256SUMS.sig"
  key_id                = "34365D9472D7468F"
  ascii_armor           = var.signing_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `arch` (String) Architecture, for example `amd64` or `arm64`
- `download_url` (String) Where the provider archive can be downloaded from
- `filename` (String) Name of the provider archive, for example `terraform-provider-internal_1.2.3_linux_amd64.zip`
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID
- `os` (String) Operating system, for example `linux`, `darwin` or `windows`
- `provider_id` (String) ID of the `terrakube_registry_provider`
- `version_id` (String) ID of the `terrakube_registry_provider_version` this is a download of

### Optional

- `ascii_armor` (String) The public GPG key, ASCII armored, that signed the `SHA256SUMS` file
- `key_id` (String) ID of the GPG key that signed the `SHA256SUMS` file
- `shasum` (String) SHA-256 checksum of the provider archive
- `shasums_signature_url` (String) Where the signature of the `SHA256SUMS` file can be downloaded from
- `shasums_url` (String) Where the `SHA256SUMS` file for the release can be downloaded from
- `source` (String) Who the signing key belongs to
- `source_url` (String) Where to read about the signing key
- `trust_signature` (String) Trust signature of the key

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Implementation ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Registry provider implementation can be imported with organization_id,provider_id,version_id,id
terraform import terrakube_registry_provider_implementation.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
